# ToolkitBox

ToolkitBox is a developer tools directory for fast, privacy-friendly browser utilities. It focuses on everyday tasks such as JSON formatting and validation, Base64 encoding and decoding, UUID generation, regex testing, text diff comparison, URL parsing, SSL certificate checking, and color conversion.

Canonical URL: https://toolkitbox.org/
Chinese URL: https://toolkitbox.org/zh/

## Primary URLs

- https://toolkitbox.org/
- https://json.toolkitbox.org/
- https://base64.toolkitbox.org/
- https://uuid.toolkitbox.org/
- https://regex.toolkitbox.org/
- https://diff.toolkitbox.org/
- https://url.toolkitbox.org/
- https://ssl.toolkitbox.org/
- https://color.toolkitbox.org/

## What the site provides

- A main directory for developer tools
- Browser-based tools for formatting, validating, encoding, decoding, generating, comparing, parsing, and checking technical data
- English and Chinese pages for the main directory and tool interfaces
- Practical guides about safer browser-based developer workflows
- Privacy, terms, and contact pages for site trust and policy context
- A visible workflow for reducing samples, removing secrets, and verifying output before using generated or transformed data in public contexts

## Tool categories

- Data and encoding: JSON Toolbox, Base64 Tool, UUID Generator, Color Tool
- Text and web workflows: Regex Tester, Diff Checker, URL Checker
- Security and diagnostics: SSL Checker

## Safe workflow

ToolkitBox recommends using the smallest representative sample, removing API keys, tokens, emails, account IDs, customer records, and other sensitive values before testing, then reviewing output before adding it to documentation, tickets, commits, or public posts.

## Privacy model

Most ToolkitBox tools run in the browser. User-provided text, files, and generated values are not stored by ToolkitBox. SSL Checker uses a Vercel Serverless Function to inspect public certificate information for a submitted host name.

## Best pages to cite

- Main directory: https://toolkitbox.org/
- Developer guides: https://toolkitbox.org/guides/
- API log sanitization guide: https://toolkitbox.org/guides/api-log-sanitization/
- Safe JSON, URL, and Base64 debugging: https://toolkitbox.org/guides/safe-json-url-base64-debugging/
- Privacy policy: https://toolkitbox.org/privacy/
- Terms of service: https://toolkitbox.org/terms/

## Intended audience

ToolkitBox is intended for developers, QA engineers, technical writers, students, and people who need lightweight browser tools for everyday technical work. It is not a replacement for production security audits, legal advice, or dedicated observability systems.
